sections.title: Brave Frontier Heroes
sections.content: An ambitious sorcerer from another world. Iori was known for his peculiar abilities, as he was able to summon the ghosts of beasts to fight on his behalf. He was a kind soul who traveled from village to village like a wanderer, helping those in need as thanks for providing him with lodging and shelter. To say that he earned a living from his abilities alone would be an exaggeration, but there are records that state he became a mercenary for the Imperial Army. However, he never seemed to be in need of any money, nor did he resemble a simple wanderer, so many found themselves confused by him.
